semiconductor_relevance: High — R-DEC specializes in vacuum technology and equipment for semiconductor research and development, making it a relevant supplier in the industry.
summary: R-DEC develops and manufactures advanced vacuum equipment tailored for semiconductor research and production. Their offerings include automatic deposition systems and monitoring tools that enhance quality and yield in semiconductor processes.

regional_presence.Japan: R-DEC is based in Tsukuba, Japan, where it has developed its ultra-high vacuum technology.
